```python
import json
from fractions import Fraction

animals = """
basenji bulldog dalmatian dragon frog goat liger llama fangtooth mouse finch
poodle snake swan walrus duck dolphin fish bee camel chihuahua shark goose
badger mule beaver pigeon ant leopard german_shepherd gadwall elk lizard
bear crow seal flamingo worm chinchilla seahorse cobra coyote owl swallow
songbird akita pelikan dove
""".split()

def atom(subject, predicate, obj=""):
    return (subject, predicate, obj)

def opposite(a):
    s, p, o = a
    return (s, p[1:] if p.startswith("!") else "!" + p, o)

facts = {
    atom("basenji", "named", "Tarzan"),
    atom("bulldog", "in", "Colombia"),
    atom("dalmatian", "swears", "dragon"),
    atom("frog", "reduced_work_hours"),
    atom("llama", "wants_to_see", "fangtooth"),
    atom("mouse", "shouts", "finch"),
    atom("poodle", "has_musical_instrument"),
    atom("poodle", "has", "cello"),
    atom("poodle", "has", "piano"),
    atom("poodle", "has", "keys"),
    atom("snake", "in", "Colombia"),
    atom("snake", "named", "Lily"),
    atom("snake", "has_blue_card"),
    atom("duck", "!swims_by", "dolphin"),
}
money = {
    "bulldog": Fraction(63), "goat": Fraction(70),
    "liger": Fraction(31), "snake": Fraction(54),
    "swan": Fraction(13), "walrus": Fraction(7),
}
friends = {"bulldog": 18}

# Each antecedent group is a disjunction; all groups must hold.
rules = []

def add(number, head, *antecedents):
    rules.append((number, head, tuple(frozenset([a]) for a in antecedents)))

def exists(number, head, predicate, obj=""):
    rules.append((
        number, head,
        (frozenset(atom(x, predicate, obj) for x in animals),)
    ))

for x in animals:
    add(1, atom(x, "pays", "fish"), atom(x, "!swims_by", "dolphin"))
    add(13, atom(x, "!builds_plant", "gadwall"), atom(x, "shouts", "elk"))
    add(15, atom(x, "!pays", "german_shepherd"),
        atom(x, "builds_plant", "lizard"))
    add(20, atom(x, "invests", "beaver"), atom(x, "!destroys_wall", "bee"))
    add(22, atom(x, "refuses_help", "coyote"), atom(x, "unites", "cobra"))
    add(29, atom(x, "!stops_victory", "leopard"),
        atom(x, "refuses_help", "chinchilla"))
    add(32, atom(x, "borrows_weapon", "chihuahua"),
        atom(x, "destroys_wall", "seahorse"))
    add(36, atom(x, "calls", "pelikan"),
        atom(x, "reveals_secret", "dragon"), atom(x, "surrenders", "shark"))

exists(2, atom("llama", "!destroys_wall", "bee"), "swears", "dragon")
add(3, atom("chihuahua", "surrenders", "shark"),
    atom("camel", "borrows_weapon", "chihuahua"))
exists(4, atom("fish", "acquires_photo", "dove"), "enjoys_company", "goose")
exists(5, atom("mule", "!acquires_photo", "beaver"), "creates_castle", "badger")
add(6, atom("pigeon", "neglects", "ant"),
    atom("snake", "borrows_weapon", "pigeon"))
add(7, atom("leopard", "swims_by", "poodle"),
    atom("german_shepherd", "stops_victory", "leopard"))
add(8, atom("poodle", "!hides_cards", "bear"), atom("poodle", "has_sharp_object"))
add(9, atom("gadwall", "enjoys_company", "goose"),
    atom("fish", "builds_plant", "gadwall"))
add(10, atom("snake", "borrows_weapon", "pigeon"), atom("snake", "in", "France"))
exists(11, atom("flamingo", "pays", "german_shepherd"), "pays", "seal")
add(12, atom("poodle", "wants_to_see", "crow"), atom("leopard", "swims_by", "poodle"))

if friends["bulldog"] > 8:
    add(14, atom("bulldog", "creates_castle", "badger"))
if money["bulldog"] > money["swan"] + money["goat"]:
    add(16, atom("bulldog", "creates_castle", "badger"))

add(17, atom("fish", "!acquires_photo", "dove"),
    atom("dolphin", "!suspects", "fish"))
add(18, atom("poodle", "!hides_cards", "bear"),
    atom("poodle", "watches_movie_released_before_ww2"))
exists(19, atom("worm", "pays", "seal"), "leaves_houses", "chinchilla")
add(21, atom("camel", "!destroys_wall", "seahorse"),
    atom("gadwall", "!brings_oil_tank", "camel"))
exists(23, atom("chihuahua", "!calls", "pelikan"), "wants_to_see", "crow")
exists(24, atom("owl", "acquires_photo", "german_shepherd"), "refuses_help", "coyote")

if money["snake"] > money["liger"] + money["walrus"]:
    add(25, atom("snake", "borrows_weapon", "pigeon"))

exists(26, atom("flamingo", "builds_plant", "lizard"), "neglects", "ant")
add(27, atom("poodle", "hides_cards", "bear"),
    atom("poodle", "has_musical_instrument"))
add(28, atom("frog", "unites", "cobra"), atom("swallow", "captures_king", "frog"))
exists(30, atom("swallow", "captures_king", "frog"), "shouts", "finch")
add(31, atom("frog", "suspects", "songbird"), atom("frog", "reduced_work_hours"))
exists(33, atom("akita", "leaves_houses", "chinchilla"), "hides_cards", "bear")
add(34, atom("fish", "builds_plant", "gadwall"), atom("duck", "pays", "fish"))
add(35, atom("beaver", "borrows_weapon", "owl"),
    atom("mule", "!acquires_photo", "beaver"))
add(37, atom("beaver", "!borrows_weapon", "owl"), atom("llama", "invests", "beaver"))
add(38, atom("german_shepherd", "stops_victory", "leopard"),
    atom("owl", "acquires_photo", "german_shepherd"),
    atom("flamingo", "!pays", "german_shepherd"))
add(39, atom("poodle", "hides_cards", "bear"), atom("poodle", "!has", "keys"))
exists(40, atom("camel", "destroys_wall", "seahorse"), "acquires_photo", "dove")

preferred = {
    (13, 34), (15, 11), (17, 4), (18, 27), (18, 39),
    (21, 40), (29, 38), (35, 37), (36, 23), (8, 27), (8, 39),
}

def applicable(rule, known):
    return all(group & known for group in rule[2])

def step(known):
    candidates = [r for r in rules if applicable(r, known)]
    accepted = [
        r for r in candidates
        if not any(
            q[1] == opposite(r[1]) and (q[0], r[0]) in preferred
            for q in candidates
        )
    ]
    return facts | {r[1] for r in accepted}, accepted

known = set(facts)
seen = set()
settled = False
for _ in range(1000):
    signature = frozenset(known)
    if signature in seen:
        break
    seen.add(signature)
    updated, accepted = step(known)
    if updated == known:
        settled = True
        break
    known = updated

if not settled:
    print("UNSUPPORTED")
else:
    target = atom("chihuahua", "calls", "pelikan")
    negative = opposite(target)
    if target in known and negative in known:
        print("UNSUPPORTED")
    else:
        answer = (
            "proved" if target in known
            else "disproved" if negative in known
            else "unknown"
        )

        # Reconstruct a finite support proof from accepted rules.
        proved = set(facts)
        proof = {}
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for number, head, groups in accepted:
                if head not in proved and all(g & proved for g in groups):
                    premises = [min(g & proved) for g in groups]
                    proved.add(head)
                    proof[head] = (number, premises)
                    changed = True

        support_rules = set()
        visited = set()

        def collect(a):
            if a in visited:
                return
            visited.add(a)
            if a in proof:
                number, premises = proof[a]
                support_rules.add(number)
                for premise in premises:
                    collect(premise)

        if answer != "unknown":
            collect(target if answer == "proved" else negative)

        opposing = []
        for number, head, groups in rules:
            if head == target and not applicable((number, head, groups), known):
                missing = [
                    [" ".join(a) for a in sorted(group)]
                    for group in groups if not group & known
                ]
                opposing.append({"rule": number, "missing": missing})

        print(json.dumps({
            "final_answer": answer,
            "evidence": {
                "support_rules": sorted(support_rules),
                "opposing_rules_missing_antecedents": opposing,
                "snake_money_comparison": (
                    money["snake"] > money["liger"] + money["walrus"]
                ),
                "bulldog_friends_exceed_eight": friends["bulldog"] > 8,
                "effective_priority": [
                    [high, low] for high, low in sorted(preferred)
                    if high in support_rules
                    and any(r[0] == low and applicable(r, known) for r in rules)
                ],
            }
        }, separators=(",", ":")))
```
